examples.text: Die Amerikaner der 1920er Jahre sahen ein historisches Ereignis vergagt, sie ließen den Film floppen.

glosses: Resembling, or characteristic of a gimmick.

examples.text: What isn't so gimmicky is the Aggro System, where you draw fire onto yourself by acting aggressive, while your partner sneaks off blindsiding distracted enemies. Aggro depends on how big your current weapon is and how often you act aggressive.
